continuity: The allied force won its first Qinghai battle in half a shichen, killing over a thousand enemies; about thirty allies were wounded and none died.
The force found a reanimated Kunlun Sect Disciple resembling a victim of Wei Zhong’s Corpse Art; Jin suspects Ma Sanbao may have joined Dark Heaven, but this is unconfirmed.
Rotting, bloodred-eyed birds were watching the allied force from the trees, suggesting the reanimated monsters are also monitoring them.
plot: Jin Taekyung’s allied force wins its first battle in Qinghai in half a shichen, killing over a thousand enemies with around thirty wounded and no deaths. Among the enemy dead, Jin finds a reanimated Kunlun Sect Disciple whose condition resembles the Corpse Art used by Wei Zhong, leading Jin and Jeong Hogun to suspect Ma Sanbao is with Dark Heaven. Jin worries Dark Heaven’s hundred-thousand-strong army may include jiangshi and that the Lord of Heaven may appear. A bird with rotting flesh and bloodred eyes reveals that reanimated monsters are also watching from the trees; Jin orders the Great Sir to kill any more such birds, then leaves the stopped Kunlun monster behind as the group prepares for pursuit.

active_continuity: Jin’s allied force won its first battle in Qinghai with about thirty wounded and no fatalities.
A reanimated Kunlun Sect Disciple and rotting birds were found watching or confronting the allied force; Jin suspects Ma Sanbao may be with Dark Heaven.
Jin senses the Lord of Heaven’s intended moment is approaching and is deeply connected to him.
open_questions: Is Ma Sanbao with Dark Heaven, and has he spread the Corpse Art to others?
Are Dark Heaven’s forces broadly composed of reanimated corpses?
What is the Lord of Heaven seeking through Jin, and when will he appear?
How many reanimated creatures are monitoring the allied force, and where are the pursuers?
